Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 [tag/del]
Misc. Notes Test of new Embertone "Blakus" solo cello sample library. Took Elaine Fine's MIDI file, imported into Cubase and loaded the Embertone "Blakus" Solo Cello (all playing legato patch) along with LA Scoring strings legato patches for the violins and viola (with the Baroque tone setting). Kept the MIDI Dynamics more or less as in the original MIDI file but tweaked a lot of the MIDI parameters. Each channel was processed with 2CAudio Breeze reverb and the stereo output was passed through 2CAudio B2 Medium Hall reverb.

Misc. Notes Here, the four known manuscript sources have been typeset and laid out in score format principally in order to make for an easy comparison of the bowings (slurs). This is not an academic, scholarly work, in the sense that there are a few typos (note errors) and not all of the minor differences in notes and rhythms between the different manuscripts have been reproduced. We have however tried to reproduce as closely as possible the ambiguities in the placements and shapes of the slurs of the original manuscripts. Two playing editions are also offered: an Edited one (with fingering and bowing suggestions) and a Clean Version (with nothing but the notes).For best results, print on A4 paper.
